Noah (AE): Heads-up. Aegis Capital's CIO just escalated to legal + procurement. They're pausing stage-2 of the POC until we provide: 1) explicit BYOK integration timeline + attestation, 2) a fixed egress IP list and cutover plan, 3) a temporary latency commitment (p95). They also want clarity on trial economics for the board. Need internal decision ASAP. :triage:

Sofia (SE): Reproduced issue from their lab environment: TLS sessions intermittently reset when routed through their company proxy. I captured traces showing the TLS client hello gets a TCP RST from their proxy after ~15s. Could be a DPI timeout or port rewrite.

Sofia (SE): Short repro I ran from their jump host:
```
curl -Iv --resolve api.infer.redwood.com:443:3.121.11.77 https://api.infer.redwood.com/health
# observed: SSL handshake starts, then RST from 10.10.0.1 (their proxy)
```

Vikram (Security): We can deliver a BYOK onboarding plan and a one-page attestation for key handling within 24h. BYOK flow supports AWS KMS and external HSM via KMIP. Legal will need to sign a small DPA addendum for key access logs. I'll draft the attestation and include SOC2/pen-test excerpts. @Zoe can you request the questionnaire and highlight what the CISO flagged?

Riley (Infra): Proposed mitigation: spin up a 14-day dedicated sandbox in their region with static egress IPs + optional private-link. I can reserve 3 static IPs: 3.121.11.77, 3.121.11.78, 3.121.11.79 and stand up a dedicated pool (2 nodes). Cost estimate ~ $4k/day. If we offer credits, suggest $35k for 14 days or $60k for 30 days. For the latency commitment (p95 <= 220ms), dedicated pool + private-link should meet it.

Carla (Head of Sales): My recommendation: approve a 14-day dedicated sandbox with BYOK onboarding help and private-link. Offer credits up to $40k contingent on a 12-month reserved commitment within 30 days of trial. Need revenue ops signoff for the credit cap. If revenue won't approve, fallback is a 7-day trial with 50% smaller credit.

Zoe (CS): I'll open the security questionnaire and ask the CISO to mark the gating questions. I'll also set up a CISO-runbook call tomorrow and prep a short deck showing the BYOK flow and network options.

deploy-bot: deployment 1824010105 created aegis-sandbox-dedicated-eu-west-1 (2x-node). Egress IPs reserved: 3.121.11.77, 3.121.11.78, 3.121.11.79.

Noah (AE): Action items: 
- @Zoe: kickoff questionnaire + schedule CISO call.
- @Vikram: deliver BYOK attestation + list required DPA changes.
- @Riley: confirm 7/14/30 day infra costs and exact credit ask.
- @Carla: confirm credit cap decision and revops path.

Noah (AE): Question for execs: can we approve up to $40k in trial credits and prioritize a 24h DPA review to unblock Aegis? Need a yes/no within 18h or they will pause the POC.
